messages:
maya: FYI vendor Zenith just flagged APAC allocation oversubscription for our H100 order, looks like 40% of the wave is delayed.

tom: ugh. which SKUs and which sites impacted?

vendor_zenith: Zenith Support: Hi — confirmed delay on H100-80GB (sku: H100-80G-P) for ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1. ETA sliding ~10–14 business days due to freight rebook. Partial RMA possible for DOA units.

li: Can they split shipments? we can accept partials into sg and jp hubs separately, but need AWBs and customs docs before EOD.

vendor_zenith: Zenith Support: Yes, we can split. Proposal:
- ship 60% now via air (priority), rest sea/air mix in next wave
- provide temporary loaners (A800s) for 14 days at no charge for priority customers

evan: What's the cost delta for the air-priority pieces? we need numbers to compare to buying extra reserved capacity.

vendor_zenith: Zenith Support: Air-priority surcharge is $1,500/unit on top of agreed price; loaners covered under warranty for affected serials. We can waive half the surcharge if Redwood covers customs brokerage.

maya: Agree to temporary loaners, but we need firm AWBs + RMA flow now. also list of serials for loaners vs final units.

vendor_zenith: Zenith Support: Draft AWBs:
```
AWB1: ZENAP1234567890 -> SIN Hub
AWB2: ZENJP9876543210 -> NRT Hub
RMA: ZN-RMA-4821 / ZN-RMA-4822
```
We'll attach commercial invoices and HS codes by 14:00 PST.

tom: Any customs HS classification risk? last time JP needed additional docs and it blocked a wave.

li: HS code for GPUs is 8471.50. But Japan asked for warranty papers + supplier declaration last time. We need Zenith to include those upfront.

vendor_zenith: Zenith Support: Noted. We'll include warranty cert and supplier declaration PDFs. Also can pre-file for JP if you grant us broker access (we need the importer id).

maya: I'll DM the importer ID to Zen rep. On the RMA side: if units arrive DOA in depot, what's the turnaround SLA for swap vs repair?

vendor_zenith: Zenith Support: Swap SLA 5 business days NA/EU, 7 business days APAC depots. Repair path ~12 business days. For partial swaps we can stage replacements in NRT to hit 5 day SLA for jp.

evan: If we accept the 60% air with surcharge, can we reclaim any credits if Zenith later meets original ETA? don't want to overpay.

vendor_zenith: Zenith Support: We can offer a rebate: if full wave ships within original window then Redwood receives a $800/unit credit for air-priority pieces.

maya: OK. TL;DR: accept split, loaners requested, vendor to provide AWBs/docs + pre-file JP. tom/li coordinate customs and importer id. please post final AWBs and RMA numbers here once filed.

ops-bot: Incident Note: Procurement delay impacting ap-southeast-1 capacity. Ticket #PR-8272 created and linked to this thread.

li: noted, will follow up on customs pre-file and attach importer id by DM.

tom: I'll update capacity chart and mark oncall/launch teams. Thanks all :thumbsup:
